in_flight.note: The exact hidden cache was already exported and fidelity-gated, so this invocation resumed at the HCX cache-stage arm.

single_quality_variable: Add lambda=0.05 centered cosine-Gram relational KD on the exact M8 classifier-input cache.
lambda_rationale: The row-normalized, double-centered Gram alignment loss is clamped to [0,2]. Lambda 0.05 therefore caps the auxiliary scalar contribution at 0.1, keeping focal plus logit-KD dominant while supplying a measurable relational gradient.

loss_contract.name: one_minus_centered_cosine_gram_alignment
loss_contract.coordinate_invariance: Independent orthogonal rotations of student or teacher coordinates do not change the loss.
loss_contract.scale_invariance: Independent positive global rescaling of student or teacher coordinates does not change the loss.
loss_contract.fewer_than_two_rows: Differentiable zero attached to the student graph.
loss_contract.replay_policy: Every replay row is relation-masked; the relation mask must exactly equal nonzero ordinary logit-KD coverage.

teacher_export.weight_source: standard fp16 model.safetensors; custom low-bit files are explicitly ignored
teacher_export.reference_precision_note: The established KD logits were exported from the canonical int8 storage-codec reconstruction. The fresh standard-fp16 forward matched 69799/70000 argmaxes (0.997128546), so the gate is 0.995 while the independent max-absolute-difference gate remains 0.25.

base_model_cache.policy: Verify and atomically seed the local Hugging Face cache, then train with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1.

fail_closed_cache_checks: unique IDs with exact original-train coverage
serializer, teacher base model, terminal token, and max length
fp16 rank-2 hidden shape, finite values, row count, and hidden size
exact model-weight SHA256 and train.jsonl SHA256 provenance
exact equality with ordinary logit-KD coverage after replay expansion
default_compatibility: All new CLI options default inactive. With no relational cache/weight, forward calls and consensus return arity remain unchanged.
prelaunch: Human terminal: .venv/bin/python colab/aadp_colab.py up a --gpu A100
go_signal: Promote only after reporting raw/2-stage delta and the required weak classes against the matched control; the separate champion full-refit card is the Public candidate.
